I had a miscarriage 35 years ago - and I still think about the baby I lost — it’s an ache that gets lessor over time, but is always there — and getting good medical help was essential so that one doesn’t bleed to death or have may other complications. FFS — miscarriage is far from a crime and a lifetime of what ifs.

Maybe some context would be good in this situation. This incident took place 2 years ago. The couple went to the hospital for miscarriage care. When at the hospital they were asked where the baby was. The couple said at home. The authorities went to the home and found the infant in an embankment OUTSIDE the home. The infant died at the scene. The couple have been charged with concealing the birth of an infant, abuse of a corpse and tampering with physical evidence.
